parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of MDF, forming the front panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main access point to the cabinet’s interior, allowing users to open and close it to store or retrieve items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the cabinet frame, enabling swinging motion for opening and closing.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet frame made of plywood, forming the structural body of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and stability to the cabinet, holding the door and shelves in place.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper shelf of the cabinet made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items inside the cabinet, dividing the internal space into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower shelf of the cabinet made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space and supports heavier items placed at the bottom of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.
